modules.name: Console bar
modules.description: The pad-driven cover-art launcher: a separate module the daemon starts, not part of the daemon.

modules.name: Idle mode
modules.description: Turns the screens black and mutes every output device, and comes back on the next key press.

modules.name: Killswitch
modules.description: Hides and mutes every running tracked app, and puts it all back when released.

modules.name: Wallpaper Engine
modules.description: Change mode when a tracked app is running, revert when no tracked app is running.

modules.name: G-Helper
modules.description: Change mode when a tracked app is running, revert when no tracked app is running.

modules.name: Rainmeter
modules.description: Switch to another layout when a tracked app is running, revert when no tracked app is running.
